title: Posner binding and melting is a quantum measurement that raises firing

statements.text: Quantum measurements occur when a pair of Posner molecules chemically bind and then melt, releasing a shower of intracellular calcium ions that can trigger neurotransmitter release and raise the probability of postsynaptic firing.

sources.quote: Quantum measurements can occur when a pair of Posner molecules chemically bind and subsequently melt, releasing a shower of intra-cellular calcium ions
